# Cüneyt Bozok

> Cüneyt Bozok (also written Cuneyt Bozok) is a Lead ServiceNow Developer at EPAM Systems, based in Istanbul, Türkiye, working across solution architecture, client discovery, maturity assessments, and pre-sales. Since 2017 he has delivered ITSM, CSM/SOM, ITOM, CMDB/CSDM, Virtual Agent, API integrations, and AI enablement (Now Assist, Agentic AI) for global enterprises.

## About

- Current role: Lead ServiceNow Developer at EPAM Systems (Senior ServiceNow Developer 2022 – 2024, Lead since 2024); scope includes solution architecture, discovery, and pre-sales
- Previously: ServiceNow Architect & Consultant at Softtech (2018 – 2022); ServiceNow Consultant at Deloitte Turkey (2017 – 2018)
- Industries: telecom, technology & networking, pharma, e-commerce, manufacturing, banking & financial services, food & consumer goods, enterprise software, wellness
- Location: Istanbul, Türkiye · Languages: English, Turkish

## Consulting focus

- Discovery and stakeholder workshops
- ITSM and CMDB/CSDM maturity assessments
- Target-state architecture and fit-to-standard evaluation
- Phased transformation roadmaps and executive presentations
- Pre-sales demos and proofs of concept
- Open to technology consulting, service transformation, and solution architecture roles

## Technical expertise

- ServiceNow ITSM, CSM, Service Order Management (SOM), ITOM
- CMDB / CSDM data foundations and maturity assessments
- Virtual Agent, Now Assist, Agentic AI, GenAI enablement
- API integrations (REST / SOAP), Flow Designer, IntegrationHub
- Target-state architecture, HLDs/LLDs, ADRs, API contracts, TM Forum Open APIs
- Discovery, fit-to-standard decisions, phased roadmaps, DevOps Change Velocity

## Certifications

ServiceNow CSA, CAD, CIS-ITSM, CIS Data Foundations (CMDB & CSDM), ITSM Professional Suite, Now Assist for ITSM Pro Plus Suite, Pre-Sales Core; micro-certifications include Agentic AI Executive, Now Assist Executive, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Virtual Agent, Service Portal, Performance Analytics, Predictive Intelligence.

## Projects

- [AssistMe](https://github.com/cuneytbozok/assistme): an open-source, read-only connector that lets Claude, ChatGPT Codex or Mistral Vibe investigate a ServiceNow instance through the user's own Chrome session. The user approves access with a code, and the AI assistant never sees their password, cookies or session tokens. Independent project, not affiliated with ServiceNow.
